package glitch

import data.glitch_lib

# List of broken or risky cryptographic algorithms
weak_crypto_algorithms := {
    "des", "3des", "des3", "md4", "md5", "sha1", "sha-1",
    "rc4", "rc2", "rc5", "blowfish", "tea", "xtea",
    "ecdh", "dsa", "dh"
}

# Attribute names that typically contain cryptographic algorithms
crypto_attr_names := {
    "digest", "hash", "algorithm", "cipher", "encryption",
    "encryption_algorithm", "hash_algorithm", "digest_algorithm",
    "checksum_algorithm", "hmac_algorithm", "key_algorithm",
    "cipher_suite", "crypto", "cryptography", "signature_algorithm",
    "mac_algorithm", "kdf_algorithm", "pbkdf2_algorithm"
}

# Check if a value contains a weak cryptographic algorithm
contains_weak_crypto(value) {
    value.ir_type == "String"
    lower := lower(value.value)
    contains(lower, weak_crypto_algorithms[_])
}

# Check nested structures for weak crypto
check_nested_for_weak_crypto(node) {
    node.ir_type == "String"
    contains_weak_crypto(node)
} else {
    node.ir_type == "Array"
    check_nested_for_weak_crypto(node.value[_])
} else {
    node.ir_type == "Hash"
    check_nested_for_weak_crypto(node.value[_])
}

# Main rule to detect weak cryptographic algorithms in attributes
Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""

    atomic_units := glitch_lib.all_atomic_units(parent)
    node := atomic_units[_]

    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(node)
    attr := attrs[_]

    # Check if attribute name suggests cryptographic usage
    attr_name_lower := lower(attr.name)
    attr_name_lower == crypto_attr_names[_]

    # Check if value contains weak crypto algorithm
    contains_weak_crypto(attr.value)

    result := {
        "type": "sec_weak_crypt",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Use of a broken or risky cryptographic algorithm - Avoid using weak cryptographic algorithms such as DES, MD5, SHA1, etc. (CWE-327)"
    }
}

# Rule to detect weak crypto in nested structures (arrays/hashes)
Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""

    atomic_units := glitch_lib.all_atomic_units(parent)
    node := atomic_units[_]

    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(node)
    attr := attrs[_]

    # Check if attribute name suggests cryptographic usage
    attr_name_lower := lower(attr.name)
    attr_name_lower == crypto_attr_names[_]

    # Check nested structures for weak crypto
    attr.value.ir_type in {"Array", "Hash"}
    check_nested_for_weak_crypto(attr.value)

    result := {
        "type": "sec_weak_crypt",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Use of a broken or risky cryptographic algorithm - Avoid using weak cryptographic algorithms such as DES, MD5, SHA1, etc. (CWE-327)"
    }
}

# Rule to detect weak crypto in function/method calls related to cryptography
Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""

    atomic_units := glitch_lib.all_atomic_units(parent)
    node := atomic_units[_]

    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(node)
    attr := attrs[_]

    attr.value.ir_type in {"FunctionCall", "MethodCall"}

    # Check function/method name for crypto-related patterns
    func_name := attr.value.name
    lower_func := lower(func_name)
    contains(lower_func, {"encrypt", "decrypt", "hash", "digest", "cipher", "crypto", "hmac", "sign", "verify"})

    # Check arguments for weak crypto algorithms
    args := attr.value.args
    arg := args[_]
    contains_weak_crypto(arg)

    result := {
        "type": "sec_weak_crypt",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Use of a broken or risky cryptographic algorithm - Avoid using weak cryptographic algorithms such as DES, MD5, SHA1, etc. (CWE-327)"
    }
}
